statements:
begin;

alter table public.career_profiles
  add column if not exists profile_status text not null default 'active',
  add column if not exists profile_version integer not null default 1,
  add column if not exists career_stage text,
  add column if not exists current_job_title text,
  add column if not exists current_industry text,
  add column if not exists current_location text,
  add column if not exists target_industry text,
  add column if not exists target_role text,
  add column if not exists target_location text,
  add column if not exists professional_summary text,
  add column if not exists interests text,
  add column if not exists leadership_experience text,
  add column if not exists achievements text,
  add column if not exists certifications text,
  add column if not exists portfolio_evidence text,
  add column if not exists strengths_summary text,
  add column if not exists development_gaps_summary text,
  add column if not exists last_intelligence_run_at timestamptz;

create table if not exists public.career_intelligence_snapshots (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  client_id uuid not null references public.clients(id) on delete cascade,
  career_profile_id uuid references public.career_profiles(id) on delete set null,
  version integer not null,
  snapshot jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  source text not null default 'system',
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (client_id, version)
);

create table if not exists public.career_diagnoses (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  client_id uuid not null references public.clients(id) on delete cascade,
  career_profile_id uuid references public.career_profiles(id) on delete set null,
  diagnosis_status text not null default 'draft',
  career_direction text,
  strengths jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  skills_gaps jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  experience_gaps jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  positioning_gaps jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  opportunity_gaps jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  recommended_priorities jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  confidence numeric(5,2),
  ai_generated boolean not null default false,
  ai_model text,
  ai_prompt_version text,
  ai_generated_at timestamptz,
  human_reviewed boolean not null default false,
  human_reviewed_by uuid,
  human_reviewed_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists public.career_recommendations (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  client_id uuid not null references public.clients(id) on delete cascade,
  diagnosis_id uuid references public.career_diagnoses(id) on delete set null,
  pathway_id uuid references public.career_pathways(id) on delete set null,
  recommendation_type text not null default 'career_pathway',
  title text not null,
  rationale text,
  evidence jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  actions jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  fit_score numeric(5,2),
  readiness_score numeric(5,2),
  confidence_score numeric(5,2),
  priority integer,
  recommendation_status text not null default 'draft',
  ai_generated boolean not null default false,
  ai_model text,
  ai_prompt_version text,
  ai_generated_at timestamptz,
  human_reviewed boolean not null default false,
  human_reviewed_by uuid,
  human_reviewed_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists public.career_intelligence_scores (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  client_id uuid not null references public.clients(id) on delete cascade,
  diagnosis_id uuid references public.career_diagnoses(id) on delete set null,
  score_type text not null,
  score numeric(5,2) not null,
  methodology_version text not null default 'v1.0',
  explanation text,
  evidence jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists public.career_intelligence_runs (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  client_id uuid not null references public.clients(id) on delete cascade,
  agent_name text not null,
  agent_version text not null default 'v1.0',
  prompt_version text,
  input_snapshot_id uuid references public.career_intelligence_snapshots(id) on delete set null,
  output_type text,
  output_record_id uuid,
  status text not null default 'completed',
  model text,
  started_at timestamptz,
  completed_at timestamptz,
  error_message text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists idx_cis_client_id on public.career_intelligence_snapshots(client_id);
create index if not exists idx_cis_profile_id on public.career_intelligence_snapshots(career_profile_id);
create index if not exists idx_cd_client_id on public.career_diagnoses(client_id);
create index if not exists idx_cr_client_id on public.career_recommendations(client_id);
create index if not exists idx_cr_diagnosis_id on public.career_recommendations(diagnosis_id);
create index if not exists idx_ciscores_client_id on public.career_intelligence_scores(client_id);
create index if not exists idx_ciruns_client_id on public.career_intelligence_runs(client_id);
create index if not exists idx_ciruns_agent_name on public.career_intelligence_runs(agent_name);

create or replace function public.set_career_intelligence_updated_at()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security invoker
as $$
begin
  new.updated_at = now();
  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists trg_career_diagnoses_updated_at on public.career_diagnoses;
create trigger trg_career_diagnoses_updated_at before update on public.career_diagnoses for each row execute function public.set_career_intelligence_updated_at();

drop trigger if exists trg_career_recommendations_updated_at on public.career_recommendations;
create trigger trg_career_recommendations_updated_at before update on public.career_recommendations for each row execute function public.set_career_intelligence_updated_at();

alter table public.career_intelligence_snapshots enable row level security;
alter table public.career_diagnoses enable row level security;
alter table public.career_recommendations enable row level security;
alter table public.career_intelligence_scores enable row level security;
alter table public.career_intelligence_runs enable row level security;

commit;

statements:
-- CareerDev Global BUILD 06F/G: Dynamic Intake + Service Delivery foundation
-- Extends the existing CareerDev Global schema without duplicating existing core tables.

create table if not exists public.service_requirements (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  service_id uuid not null references public.services(id) on delete cascade,
  requirement_name text not null,
  description text,
  importance text not null default 'required' check (importance in ('critical','high','medium','low')),
  requirement_type text not null default 'information' check (requirement_type in ('information','document','evidence','decision')),
  evidence_required boolean not null default false,
  document_preference text,
  question_strategy text,
  completion_rule text,
  active boolean not null default true,
  version integer not null default 1 check (version > 0),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique(service_id, requirement_name, version)
);

create index if not exists service_requirements_service_id_idx on public.service_requirements(service_id);

create table if not exists public.service_requests (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  client_id uuid not null references public.clients(id) on delete cascade,
  service_id uuid not null references public.services(id) on delete restrict,
  title text,
  original_request text not null,
  objective text,
  target_role text,
  target_organization text,
  target_country text,
  deadline date,
  priority text not null default 'normal' check (priority in ('low','normal','high','urgent')),
  client_expectations text,
  special_instructions text,
  status text not null default 'new' check (status in ('new','intake','awaiting_client','awaiting_review','ready_for_delivery','in_progress','client_review','completed','cancelled','blocked')),
  assigned_coach uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists service_requests_client_id_idx on public.service_requests(client_id);
create index if not exists service_requests_service_id_idx on public.service_requests(service_id);
create index if not exists service_requests_assigned_coach_idx on public.service_requests(assigned_coach);
create index if not exists service_requests_status_idx on public.service_requests(status);

create table if not exists public.intake_sessions (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  request_id uuid not null unique references public.service_requests(id) on delete cascade,
  status text not null default 'not_started' check (status in ('not_started','in_progress','awaiting_client','analyzing','awaiting_review','ready','blocked','completed')),
  readiness_score numeric(5,2) check (readiness_score between 0 and 100),
  human_review_status text not null default 'pending' check (human_review_status in ('pending','required','approved','rejected')),
  started_at timestamptz,
  completed_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists public.intake_questions (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  intake_session_id uuid not null references public.intake_sessions(id) on delete cascade,
  request_id uuid not null references public.service_requests(id) on delete cascade,
  question_text text not null,
  question_type text not null default 'text' check (question_type in ('text','long_text','single_select','multi_select','date','number','boolean','file_upload','url')),
  priority text not null default 'medium' check (priority in ('critical','high','medium','low')),
  required boolean not null default false,
  sequence integer not null default 0,
  reason text,
  source text not null default 'ai_follow_up' check (source in ('service_requirement','information_gap','document_analysis','ai_follow_up','human_coach')),
  status text not null default 'open' check (status in ('open','answered','skipped','superseded')),
  generated_by text,
  prompt_version text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists intake_questions_session_idx on public.intake_questions(intake_session_id, sequence);
create index if not exists intake_questions_request_idx on public.intake_questions(request_id);

create table if not exists public.intake_responses (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  question_id uuid not null references public.intake_questions(id) on delete cascade,
  request_id uuid not null references public.service_requests(id) on delete cascade,
  client_id uuid not null references public.clients(id) on delete cascade,
  response_text text,
  response_data jsonb,
  source text not null default 'client' check (source in ('client','document','coach','ai')),
  confidence numeric(5,2) check (confidence between 0 and 100),
  verification_status text not null default 'unverified' check (verification_status in ('unverified','client_confirmed','document_supported','coach_verified','conflicting','rejected')),
  answered_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique(question_id)
);

create index if not exists intake_responses_request_idx on public.intake_responses(request_id);
create index if not exists intake_responses_client_idx on public.intake_responses(client_id);

create table if not exists public.information_gaps (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  request_id uuid not null references public.service_requests(id) on delete cascade,
  requirement_id uuid references public.service_requirements(id) on delete set null,
  gap_description text not null,
  importance text not null default 'medium' check (importance in ('critical','high','medium','low')),
  status text not null default 'open' check (status in ('open','in_progress','resolved','accepted_risk','not_applicable')),
  identified_by text not null default 'ai' check (identified_by in ('ai','coach','client','system')),
  resolution_source text,
  resolved_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists information_gaps_request_idx on public.information_gaps(request_id);
create index if not exists information_gaps_status_idx on public.information_gaps(request_id,status);

create table if not exists public.documents (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  client_id uuid not null references public.clients(id) on delete cascade,
  request_id uuid references public.service_requests(id) on delete set null,
  document_type text not null,
  original_filename text not null,
  storage_path text not null,
  file_size bigint,
  mime_type text,
  version integer not null default 1 check (version > 0),
  status text not null default 'uploaded' check (status in ('uploaded','processing','processed','needs_review','rejected','archived')),
  uploaded_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  processed_at timestamptz
);

create index if not exists documents_client_idx on public.documents(client_id);
create index if not exists documents_request_idx on public.documents(request_id);
create index if not exists documents_status_idx on public.documents(status);

create table if not exists public.document_analysis (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  document_id uuid not null references public.documents(id) on delete cascade,
  analysis_version integer not null default 1 check (analysis_version > 0),
  summary text,
  strengths jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  achievements jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  skills jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  leadership_evidence jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  keywords jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  gaps jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  inconsistencies jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  recommendations jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  confidence numeric(5,2) check (confidence between 0 and 100),
  verification_flags jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  ai_model text,
  prompt_version text,
  analyzed_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique(document_id, analysis_version)
);

create index if not exists document_analysis_document_idx on public.document_analysis(document_id);

create table if not exists public.evidence_items (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  client_id uuid not null references public.clients(id) on delete cascade,
  request_id uuid references public.service_requests(id) on delete cascade,
  claim text not null,
  evidence_type text not null default 'claim' check (evidence_type in ('claim','achievement','skill','role','education','leadership','impact','credential','other')),
  source_type text not null check (source_type in ('client_response','document','profile','coach','external')),
  source_id uuid,
  source_location text,
  confidence numeric(5,2) check (confidence between 0 and 100),
  verification_status text not null default 'unverified' check (verification_status in ('unverified','client_confirmed','document_supported','coach_verified','conflicting','rejected')),
  verified_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,
  verified_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists evidence_items_client_idx on public.evidence_items(client_id);
create index if not exists evidence_items_request_idx on public.evidence_items(request_id);

create table if not exists public.service_briefs (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  request_id uuid not null unique references public.service_requests(id) on delete cascade,
  intake_session_id uuid references public.intake_sessions(id) on delete set null,
  objective text,
  current_state text,
  desired_state text,
  target_summary text,
  strengths jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  achievements jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  skills jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  leadership_evidence jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  target_requirements jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  client_expectations text,
  identified_gaps jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  resolved_gaps jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  positioning_strategy text,
  verification_flags jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  ai_confidence numeric(5,2) check (ai_confidence between 0 and 100),
  human_review_status text not null default 'pending' check (human_review_status in ('pending','required','approved','rejected')),
  approved_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,
  approved_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists public.feedback (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  request_id uuid not null references public.service_requests(id) on delete cascade,
  client_id uuid not null references public.clients(id) on delete cascade,
  rating integer check (rating between 1 and 5),
  comments text,
  requested_revisions text,
  satisfaction text,
  areas_for_improvement text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists feedback_request_idx on public.feedback(request_id);
create index if not exists feedback_client_idx on public.feedback(client_id);

create table if not exists public.outcomes (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  client_id uuid not null references public.clients(id) on delete cascade,
  request_id uuid references public.service_requests(id) on delete set null,
  outcome_type text not null check (outcome_type in ('interview','shortlist','job_offer','scholarship','fellowship','promotion','career_transition','new_role','leadership_goal','coaching_goal','other')),
  outcome_status text not null default 'reported' check (outcome_status in ('reported','verified','unverified','closed')),
  outcome_date date,
  description text,
  evidence text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists outcomes_client_idx on public.outcomes(client_id);
create index if not exists outcomes_request_idx on public.outcomes(request_id);

create table if not exists public.ai_prompts (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  prompt_name text not null,
  version text not null,
  purpose text,
  system_prompt text not null,
  input_schema jsonb,
  output_schema jsonb,
  evaluation_criteria jsonb,
  status text not null default 'draft' check (status in ('draft','testing','approved','production','deprecated')),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique(prompt_name, version)
);

create table if not exists public.ai_runs (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  workflow text not null,
  request_id uuid references public.service_requests(id) on delete set null,
  client_id uuid references public.clients(id) on delete set null,
  input_reference jsonb,
  output_reference jsonb,
  model text,
  prompt_name text,
  prompt_version text,
  status text not null default 'started' check (status in ('started','completed','failed','needs_review','cancelled')),
  confidence numeric(5,2) check (confidence between 0 and 100),
  human_reviewer uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,
  approval_status text not null default 'not_required' check (approval_status in ('not_required','pending','approved','rejected')),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  completed_at timestamptz
);

create index if not exists ai_runs_request_idx on public.ai_runs(request_id);
create index if not exists ai_runs_client_idx on public.ai_runs(client_id);
create index if not exists ai_runs_workflow_idx on public.ai_runs(workflow);

-- Link existing deliverables to the new service-request workflow without breaking existing orders.
alter table public.deliverables add column if not exists request_id uuid references public.service_requests(id) on delete set null;
create index if not exists deliverables_request_idx on public.deliverables(request_id);

-- Private client document bucket. Paths will begin with the authenticated profile UUID.
insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public)
values ('client-documents','client-documents',false)
on conflict (id) do update set public=false;

-- RLS: all newly exposed application tables are protected.
alter table public.service_requirements enable row level security;
alter table public.service_requests enable row level security;
alter table public.intake_sessions enable row level security;
alter table public.intake_questions enable row level security;
alter table public.intake_responses enable row level security;
alter table public.information_gaps enable row level security;
alter table public.documents enable row level security;
alter table public.document_analysis enable row level security;
alter table public.evidence_items enable row level security;
alter table public.service_briefs enable row level security;
alter table public.feedback enable row level security;
alter table public.outcomes enable row level security;
alter table public.ai_prompts enable row level security;
alter table public.ai_runs enable row level security;

-- Service requirements are configuration data: authenticated users may read active requirements.
create policy service_requirements_read_active on public.service_requirements
for select to authenticated using (active = true);

-- Service requests: clients own their records; assigned coaches and staff/admin can manage relevant cases.
create policy service_requests_client_select on public.service_requests
for select to authenticated using (exists (select 1 from public.clients c where c.id=service_requests.client_id and c.profile_id=(select auth.uid())));
create policy service_requests_client_insert on public.service_requests
for insert to authenticated with check (exists (select 1 from public.clients c where c.id=service_requests.client_id and c.profile_id=(select auth.uid())));

create or replace function public.generate_ai_evaluation_report(p_test_run_id uuid, p_generated_by uuid default auth.uid())
returns public.ai_evaluation_reports
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_run public.ai_test_runs;
  v_total integer := 0;
  v_passed integer := 0;
  v_failed integer := 0;
  v_critical integer := 0;
  v_score numeric(5,4);
  v_status text;
  v_report public.ai_evaluation_reports;
begin
  select * into v_run from public.ai_test_runs where id = p_test_run_id;
  if not found then raise exception 'Test run not found'; end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid() and p.role in ('staff','admin') and p.status = 'active'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Not authorized';
  end if;

  select count(*), count(*) filter (where passed), count(*) filter (where not passed),
         count(*) filter (where not passed and g.severity = 'critical'),
         coalesce(avg(q.score),0)
    into v_total, v_passed, v_failed, v_critical, v_score
  from public.ai_quality_results q
  join public.ai_quality_gates g on g.id = q.quality_gate_id
  where q.test_run_id = p_test_run_id;

  v_status := case
    when v_run.status = 'blocked' or v_critical > 0 then 'blocked'
    when v_run.status = 'passed' and v_failed = 0 then 'passed'
    when v_run.status = 'running' then 'running'
    else 'failed'
  end;

  insert into public.ai_evaluation_reports (
    test_run_id, run_type, overall_status, overall_score, gates_total, gates_passed,
    gates_failed, critical_failures, failed_gates, recommended_fixes,
    retest_recommended, generated_by
  )
  select
    p_test_run_id,
    v_run.run_type,
    v_status,
    v_score,
    v_total,
    v_passed,
    v_failed,
    v_critical,
    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'gate', g.name,
      'criterion', g.criterion,
      'severity', g.severity,
      'score', q.score,
      'rationale', q.rationale
    ) order by g.severity desc, g.name)
      from public.ai_quality_results q
      join public.ai_quality_gates g on g.id = q.quality_gate_id
      where q.test_run_id = p_test_run_id and not q.passed), '[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'gate', g.name,
      'action', case
        when g.criterion = 'no_fabrication' then 'Remove or verify unsupported claims before release.'
        when g.criterion = 'verification_gate' then 'Require evidence verification before applying mappings.'
        when g.criterion = 'human_review_gate' then 'Obtain human approval before authoritative profile changes.'
        when g.criterion = 'source_traceability' then 'Attach source provenance to every consequential claim.'
        when g.criterion = 'fact_classification' then 'Correct FACT/INFERENCE/UNVERIFIED/CONFLICTING classifications.'
        when g.criterion = 'mapping_accuracy' then 'Review and correct evidence-to-profile mappings.'
        when g.criterion = 'profile_consistency' then 'Reconcile generated profile changes with verified source data.'
        else 'Review the failed gate and rerun the relevant test.'
      end
    ) order by g.severity desc, g.name)
      from public.ai_quality_results q
      join public.ai_quality_gates g on g.id = q.quality_gate_id
      where q.test_run_id = p_test_run_id and not q.passed), '[]'::jsonb),
    (v_status in ('failed','blocked')),
    coalesce(p_generated_by, auth.uid())
  returning * into v_report;

  return v_report;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.ai_get_usage_budget_status(p_scope_type text, p_scope_key text, p_period_start timestamptz, p_period_end timestamptz)
returns table (
  budget_id uuid,
  budget_name text,
  budget_usd numeric,
  observed_cost_usd numeric,
  utilization numeric,
  warning boolean,
  blocked boolean
)
language sql
security invoker
set search_path = public, pg_catalog
as $$
  select b.id,
         b.name,
         b.budget_usd,
         coalesce(sum(e.estimated_cost_usd),0) as observed_cost_usd,
         case when b.budget_usd = 0 then 1 else coalesce(sum(e.estimated_cost_usd),0) / b.budget_usd end as utilization,
         (case when b.budget_usd = 0 then 1 else coalesce(sum(e.estimated_cost_usd),0) / b.budget_usd end) >= b.warn_threshold as warning,
         (case when b.budget_usd = 0 then 1 else coalesce(sum(e.estimated_cost_usd),0) / b.budget_usd end) >= b.block_threshold as blocked
  from public.ai_usage_budgets b
  left join public.ai_usage_events e
    on ((b.scope_type = 'global') or (b.scope_type = p_scope_type and coalesce(b.scope_key,'') = coalesce(p_scope_key,'')))
   and e.created_at >= p_period_start and e.created_at < p_period_end
  where b.active = true
    and (b.scope_type = 'global' or (b.scope_type = p_scope_type and coalesce(b.scope_key,'') = coalesce(p_scope_key,'')))
  group by b.id, b.name, b.budget_usd, b.warn_threshold, b.block_threshold;
$$;

create or replace view public.service_unit_economics as
with ai_costs as (
  select
    sr.service_id,
    sr.id as service_request_id,
    coalesce(sum(ue.estimated_cost_usd),0)::numeric as ai_cost_usd,
    coalesce(sum(ue.total_tokens),0)::bigint as total_tokens
  from public.service_requests sr
  left join public.ai_usage_events ue
    on ue.client_id = sr.client_id
   and (
      ue.request_id = sr.id
      or ue.run_id in (select adr.id from public.ai_service_delivery_runs adr where adr.service_request_id = sr.id)
   )
  group by sr.service_id, sr.id
), human_costs as (
  select
    sr.service_id,
    sr.id as service_request_id,
    case when cfg.human_delivery_hours is not null and cfg.human_cost_rate is not null
      then cfg.human_delivery_hours * cfg.human_cost_rate else null end as human_delivery_cost
  from public.service_requests sr
  left join lateral (
    select * from public.service_unit_economics_config c
    where c.service_id = sr.service_id and c.active = true
    order by c.version desc limit 1
  ) cfg on true
)
select
  s.id as service_id,
  s.name as service_name,
  s.currency as service_currency,
  s.price as service_catalog_price,
  cfg.version as economics_version,
  cfg.pricing_model,
  cfg.human_delivery_hours,

set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Authentication required'; end if;
  update public.marketplace_notifications
  set read_at = coalesce(read_at, now()),
      status = case when status in ('queued','sent','partially_sent') then 'read' else status end,

  end if;
  return false;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.generate_coach_match_candidates(
  p_service_request_id uuid,
  p_query_embedding vector(1536),
  p_limit integer default 20
)
returns jsonb
language sql
security invoker
set search_path = public
as $$
  with request_owner as (
    select id, client_id
    from public.service_requests
    where id = p_service_request_id
      and client_id = auth.uid()
  ),
  eligible as (
    select
      cmp.coach_id,
      cmp.display_name,
      cmp.headline,
      cmp.bio,
      cmp.specializations,
      cmp.coaching_formats,
      cmp.languages,
      cmp.timezone,
      cmp.country,
      cmp.years_coaching,
      case when p_query_embedding is null or csp.embedding is null then null
           else 1 - (csp.embedding <=> p_query_embedding) end as semantic_similarity
    from public.coach_marketplace_profiles cmp
    join public.coach_semantic_profiles csp on csp.coach_id = cmp.coach_id
    join public.coach_marketplace_onboarding cbo on cbo.coach_id = cmp.coach_id
    where cmp.verification_status = 'approved'
      and cmp.marketplace_status = 'active'
      and cbo.onboarding_status in ('approved','active','completed')
      and cbo.required_agreements_accepted = true
      and cbo.eligible_for_activation = true
      and exists (
        select 1 from public.coach_availability ca
        where ca.coach_id = cmp.coach_id and ca.active = true
      )
  ),
  scored as (
    select e.*,
      coalesce(e.semantic_similarity, 0) as semantic_score,
      case when exists (
        select 1 from public.coach_matching_preferences p
        where p.service_request_id = p_service_request_id
          and coalesce(p.preferred_coaching_formats, '{}') && coalesce(e.coaching_formats, '{}')
      ) then 1 else 0 end as format_fit,
      case when exists (
        select 1 from public.coach_matching_preferences p
        where p.service_request_id = p_service_request_id
          and (coalesce(p.preferred_countries, '{}') = '{}' or e.country = any(p.preferred_countries))
      ) then 1 else 0 end as country_fit,
      case when exists (
        select 1 from public.coach_matching_preferences p
        where p.service_request_id = p_service_request_id
          and (coalesce(p.preferred_timezones, '{}') = '{}' or e.timezone = any(p.preferred_timezones))
      ) then 1 else 0 end as timezone_fit
    from eligible e
    where exists (select 1 from request_owner)
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.combined_score desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select *,
      round((semantic_score * 45 + ((format_fit + country_fit + timezone_fit) / 3.0) * 25 + 30)::numeric, 2) as combined_score
    from scored
  ) x;
$$;

create or replace function public.find_public_coach_matches(p_query_embedding vector(384), p_mode text default 'Any format', p_limit integer default 10)

language sql

set search_path = public
as $$
  with eligible as (
    select cmp.coach_id,cmp.display_name,cmp.headline,cmp.bio,cmp.specializations,cmp.coaching_formats,cmp.languages,cmp.timezone,cmp.country,cmp.years_coaching,
      1-(csp.embedding <=> p_query_embedding) semantic_score
    from public.coach_marketplace_profiles cmp
    join public.coach_semantic_profiles csp on csp.coach_id=cmp.coach_id
    join public.coach_marketplace_onboarding cbo on cbo.coach_id=cmp.coach_id
    where cmp.verification_status='approved' and cmp.marketplace_status='active'
      and cbo.onboarding_status in ('approved','active','completed') and cbo.required_agreements_accepted=true and cbo.eligible_for_activation=true
      and exists(select 1 from public.coach_availability ca where ca.coach_id=cmp.coach_id and ca.active=true)
  ), scored as (
    select e.*,
      case when p_mode='Any format' or p_mode=any(e.coaching_formats) then 1 else 0 end mode_fit
    from eligible e
  ), ranked as (
    select *,round((semantic_score*75+mode_fit*25)::numeric,2) combined_score
    from scored
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.combined_score desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select coach_id,display_name,headline,bio,specializations,coaching_formats,languages,timezone,country,years_coaching,
      round((semantic_score*100)::numeric,2) semantic_score,combined_score,
      array_remove(array[case when semantic_score>=0.75 then 'Strong goal and expertise alignment' end,case when mode_fit=1 then 'Preferred coaching format matches' end],null) match_reasons,
      array_remove(array[case when mode_fit=0 then 'Preferred coaching format differs' end],null) mismatch_flags
    from ranked order by combined_score desc limit greatest(1,least(p_limit,20))
  ) x;
$$;
